hypothesis: A second synthetic-pretrained table transformer could make different errors, particularly when it receives similar support rows. Use the publisher's unmodified Tab2D core with frozen weights and no AutoGluon fine-tuning.
global: Two disjoint stratified contexts of 384 fit rows. Use deterministic category codes with two different seeded orders and average probabilities. Columns and labels come only from the fitting packet.
local: Select four representatives by deterministic farthest-first categorical distance to training rows. Give each representative the nearest 384 fitting rows with seeded tie breaking and require every class. Route each question to the nearest representative. No learned neural parameters.
evaluation: Use the three previously used training-only development panels. Seal both challengers' predictions before opening the 808 nomination answers. Allow standalone and .125, .25, .5 blends with the previous research pair or retain it. Freeze the winner, then check the separate 817 and 807 rows. Require +.003 pooled and nonnegative on each to advance to an ordinary-entry study. Report zero optimized foundation weights and the exact number of provisioned contexts. No designated validation, test, task-specific names, or model API.
resources: MPS if a synthetic probe passes, otherwise CPU. Maximum query batch 96, reset temporary compute state between contexts. Use the unmodified non-flash upstream attention implementation.
